{{Top|leg}}
A '''flux-field generator''' was a device used to melt solid [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] had planned to use one to free the frozen form of [[Trioculus]] when he was interrupted by the arrival of [[Heingort Giddis]]<ref name="SPIN Declass">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref>, masquerading as the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Dark Side Prophet]], [[Jedgar]].<ref name="MFMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>
